facts.value: The Concurrent Enrollment Program provides students with the opportunity to complete their associate degree in nursing while simultaneously completing their Bachelor of Science in Nursing through ASU.
Students take nursing courses in-person at their community college and online through ASU.
Upon completion, students will graduate with both their ADN from the community college and their BSN from ASU.

value: Reduce time to earn BSN while completing associate degree.
ASU CEP tuition is offered at a reduced rate regardless of residency status.
100% online courses provide flexibility to earn degree.
Students can transfer and apply up to 75 credits from their ADN program.
